description: Crop an image from the selected company's media library (or a Pexels or Unsplash photo) into a new hosted image and return it with a ready-to-insert Sequenzy image block. The crop is baked into the file, so Gmail, Outlook and every other client show exactly the chosen area, unlike cropHeight with objectFit:'cover', which some clients ignore. Provide either crop (fractions of the image) or aspectRatio (the largest centered crop of that shape, optionally moved toward focusX/focusY), not both. The original stays in the library and the returned imageBlock.crop records it, so the editor can re-open or undo the crop. Retrying the same crop returns the same asset. For other external images, call upload_image_asset first and crop the returned URL.

altText.description: Accessible description stored with the cropped asset and returned as imageBlock.alt.

aspectRatio.description: Width to height, such as "16:9", "1:1", "4:5" or "1.91:1", between 1:10 and 10:1. Crops the largest area of that shape. Provide aspectRatio or crop, not both.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

crop.description: Area to keep as fractions of the upright image: x and y are the top-left corner, width and height the size, all from 0 to 1 and inside the image. Provide crop or aspectRatio, not both.

displayWidthPercent.description: Responsive image width as a percentage of the email content area. Defaults to 100.

focusX.description: With aspectRatio only: horizontal center of the crop as a fraction of the image width. Defaults to 0.5.

focusY.description: With aspectRatio only: vertical center of the crop as a fraction of the image height. Defaults to 0.5.

sourceUrl.description: Hosted URL of the original image: an asset URL from the media library or upload_image_asset, or a Pexels/Unsplash photo URL. To change an existing crop, pass the original from imageBlock.crop.sourceSrc, not the cropped URL.

name: crop_image_asset

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `crop_image_asset` MCP tool.

asset.description: The hosted cropped image asset record returned by Sequenzy.

crop.description: Crop record (sourceSrc, croppedSrc, x, y, width, height) stored on the image block so the editor can re-open or undo the crop.

imageBlock.description: Ready-to-insert Sequenzy image block using the cropped asset URL.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.
